topic.title: Is it possible to access replay data from our submitted agents?

messages.content: Yes - more information can be found here: https://github.com/Kaggle/kaggle-cli/blob/main/docs/simulation_competitions.md
messages.rawMarkdown: Yes - more information can be found here: https://github.com/Kaggle/kaggle-cli/blob/main/docs/simulation_competitions.md

messages.content:
I would like to know whether it is possible to download or access the replay data generated by my submitted agents after evaluation.

If replay data is available, where can I find it? Can it be accessed through the competition page, submission results, or an API?

Thank you!
